summary: Universal-quantifier hole is genuinely closed: I re-ran both named mutants (islice(_packaged_files(),1) and an in-loop accumulator reset) and each now dies solely on test_base_fingerprint_changes_for_every_file_of_a_multi_file_tree; traversal yields zeta,alpha,nested/beta,nested/deeper/gamma so two mutated files are strictly interior, the same-length mutation forbids a length-only shortcut, and per-iteration re-measurement of 'before' makes a broken restore unable to fake a pass. Path and bytes conjuncts independently confirmed by killing path-drop and contents-drop mutants, and exclusion tightness by killing an over-broad docker/ exclusion. Residual non-blocking gaps: removing the digest's length framing survives the whole suite (only a pathological rename collides), and the path conjunct is still exercised only on a single-file tree.
